instruction: The Standard toolbar disappeared. Please restore it so I can access the basic tools.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(5); pyautogui.press('esc'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('f10'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('right', presses=2, interval=0.1); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('down', presses=11, interval=0.1); pyautogui.press('enter')

metadata.explanation: Task requires restoring/showing the Standard toolbar in LibreOffice Impress. The evaluator checks the accessibility tree for the Standard toolbar element. Similar difficulty to original - simple toolbar visibility task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses accessibility tree to verify toolbar visibility
Metric function properly handles expected parameter as rules dict (correct framework usage)
Searches for 'tool-bar' element with name='Standard' in XML tree - semantically correct approach
Complete coverage: instruction requires restoring Standard toolbar, evaluator checks Standard toolbar presence
No postconfig needed - toolbar state persists after restoration
Robust error handling with try/except for XML parsing failures
Expected value 'Standard' correctly matches instruction requirement
